scripts.env:client: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const src = 'client/.env.example'; const dest = 'client/.env'; if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); } console.log('Created client/.env');"
scripts.env:server: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const src = 'server/.env.example'; const dest = 'server/.env'; if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); } console.log('Created server/.env');"
scripts.env:create: npm run env:client && npm run env:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:client && npm run lint:fix:server
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.supabase:link: node -e "console.log('Pending Sprint 2: link Supabase project and local CLI config.');"
scripts.supabase:push: node -e "console.log('Pending Sprint 2: push migrations to remote Supabase project.');"
scripts.supabase:reset: node -e "console.log('Pending Sprint 2: reset the remote Supabase project state.');"
scripts.supabase:reset:local: node -e "console.log('Pending Sprint 2: reset local Supabase stack only.');"
scripts.supabase:seed: node -e "console.log('Pending Sprint 2: seed local development data.');"
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:repo && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint:check && npm run format:check && npm run build
